_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

SIGR50MKplPxkwHqzYpK_w.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第 11 週(3/16-22)全球陽性率上升為 2.47%,其中東南亞區署、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。 德國疫情呈下降,目前處低點,第 13 週新增 282 例病例;變異株以 NB.1.8.1(68%)為主,另變異株 BA.3.2 占比上升,從今年9-10 週的 5%,上升至第 10-11 週的 11%。 英國疫情略升,第 13 週實驗室檢測陽性率略增至 2.1%。變異株以 XFG 占大宗,BA.3 於 2/16-3/1 占比為 2.13%。 GISAID 去年 12 月迄今的病毒株定序資料顯示,BA.3.2 多數易感宿主為年輕族群,其中,愛爾蘭高達 38.8%及法國 27%病例為 18 歲以下族群;美國 49.1%及盧森堡 23.4%病例為 10 歲以下族群,與其他變異株感染病患的年齡層分布顯著不同。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以 XFG 占比最高(占 31.44%),其次為NB.1.8.1(30.68%),BA.3.2 占比上升至 12.5%。WHO 公布之 COVID-19 全球長期快速風險評估(第 9 版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑒於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自 2022 年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為 Omicron JN.1 及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,然有 6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段 COVID-19 尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO 指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
SIGR50MKplPxkwHqzYpK_w.en: Epidemic update: In week 11 of this year (16–22 March), the global positivity rate rose to 2.47%, with notable increases in the WHO South-East Asia and Eastern Mediterranean regions. Germany's epidemic is declining and is currently at a low point, with 282 new cases reported in week 13. NB.1.8.1 (68%) remains the predominant variant, while the share of BA.3.2 has risen from 5% in weeks 9–10 of this year to 11% in weeks 10–11. The UK's epidemic has risen slightly, and laboratory test positivity increased slightly to 2.1% in week 13. XFG accounts for the largest share of variants, and BA.3 accounted for 2.13% during 16 February–1 March. Sequencing data in GISAID since December last year show that most BA.3.2 infections occur in young people: 38.8% of cases in the Republic of Ireland and 27% in France were under 18 years, and 49.1% of cases in the United States and 23.4% in Luxembourg were under 10 years, a significantly different age distribution from patients infected with other variants. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally (31.44%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (30.68%), and BA.3.2 has risen to 12.5%. WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

q02iJuGx7Mri6EKxyM1-4w.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年9/26累計141國/地區報告16萬2千餘例確診病例,其中,至少430例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第39週累計96國/地區報告4萬2千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬5,363例、美洲區3,314例、歐洲區2,044例、西太平洋區1,229例、東南亞區95例及東地中海區40例。東地中海與歐洲疫情上升,非洲、美洲、西太平洋、東南亞疫情下降。  其他更新:  美國加州9/15報告新增1例I型病例,為該州第2例、該國第6例I型病例,病患近期具中東旅遊史,與其他病例無流行病學關聯。*加州首例為2024年11月報告。 塞內加爾自今年8月報告首例截至9/23累計4例病例,首例為境外移入Ib型病例,案2確診IIb型,與案1無流行病學關聯,案3、4為案2接觸者,推測感染為IIb型病例,當局已匡列40名接觸者。 愛爾蘭9/18報告3例Ib型確診病例及1例疑病例,首例確診病例與具中東旅遊史之疑病例具流行病關聯,餘2例確診者為首例之密切接觸者,其中有1名兒童,目前病患皆已康復。當局評估該國風險仍低,並呼籲旅外民眾應採取必要公衛措施。 科威特8/10報告該國首例M痘病例,為IIb型,迄今累計3例確診病例,首例具中國旅遊史,當局已疫調並匡列接觸者。 澳大利亞9/9報告新增1例Ib型病例,具中國及菲律賓旅遊史,為該國自2024年1月迄今第3例,當局已疫調並追蹤接觸者,並協助接種暴露後疫苗。 泰國9/9報告新增Ib型病例,病患為成年男性,具阿曼旅遊史。為該國自2024年1月迄今第6例Ib型病例。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5公布經IHR緊急委員會第5次會議討論,建議中止國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),WHO於記者會表示,剛果民主共和國/蒲隆地/獅子山/烏干達等國病例/死亡數持續下降,且對疾病傳播及嚴重度風險因素已逐漸掌握,受影響國家亦建立持續應對能力,不再構成PHEIC,惟提醒PHEIC解除並不代表威脅已經消失,非洲CDC仍持續列為非洲緊急衛生事件。WHO評估全球公共衛生風險為中等,由於不同基因型持續流行、監測及診斷能力不足、資金缺乏及社區參與需更多資源,WHO已將長期建議延長至2026年8月。
q02iJuGx7Mri6EKxyM1-4w.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 26 September this year, 141 countries and areas have reported more than 162,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 430 died (CFR 0.2%). Year to date as of week 39, 96 countries and areas have reported more than 42,000 confirmed cases: 35,363 in the African Region, 3,314 in the Region of the Americas, 2,044 in the European Region, 1,229 in the Western Pacific Region, 95 in the South-East Asia Region and 40 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have risen in the Eastern Mediterranean and Europe and declined in Africa, the Americas, the Western Pacific and South-East Asia. Other updates: On 15 September, California, United States, reported one new clade I case, the state's second and the country's sixth clade I case. The patient had recent travel history to the Middle East and no epidemiological link to other cases. The state's first case was reported in November 2024. Senegal reported its first case in August this year; as of 23 September, a cumulative 4 cases had been reported. The first case was an imported clade Ib case. Case 2 was confirmed as clade IIb and had no epidemiological link to case 1; cases 3 and 4 were contacts of case 2, and their infection is presumed to be clade IIb. Authorities have identified 40 contacts. Ireland reported three confirmed clade Ib cases and one suspected case on 18 September. The first confirmed case was epidemiologically linked to a suspected case with travel history to the Middle East; the other two confirmed cases were close contacts of the first, one of whom was a child. All patients have recovered. Authorities assess the country's risk as still low and urge travellers abroad to take necessary public health measures. Kuwait reported its first mpox case on 10 August; it was clade IIb, and 3 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. The first case had travel history to China, and authorities have conducted an investigation and identified contacts. Australia reported one new clade Ib case on 9 September, with travel history to China and the Philippines; it is the country's third case since January 2024. Authorities have investigated and followed up contacts, and have helped administer post-exposure vaccines. Thailand reported a new clade Ib case on 9 September; the patient is an adult man with travel history to Oman, and it is the country's sixth clade Ib case since January 2024. Assessment and recommendations: On 5 September, WHO, following the fifth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee, recommended ending the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). At a press conference, WHO said case and death numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Sierra Leone and Uganda continue to decline, risk factors for transmission and severity are increasingly understood, and affected countries have established sustained response capacity, so the event no longer constitutes a PHEIC. WHO cautioned that ending the PHEIC does not mean the threat has disappeared, and Africa CDC continues to treat the event as an emergency health event in Africa. WHO assesses the global public health risk as moderate. Because different genotypes continue to circulate, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, funding is lacking, and community engagement requires more resources, WHO has extended its long-term recommendations to August 2026.

HMnQ_pEP_Wxd86FF3yM9wA.zh: 愛爾蘭於7/23報告9例病例,其中1例死亡,當局已下架逾200種超市即食商品,感染源仍調查中,另該國過去平均每年報告14-22例病例。
HMnQ_pEP_Wxd86FF3yM9wA.en: Ireland reported 9 cases as of 23 July, including 1 death. Authorities have withdrawn more than 200 ready-to-eat supermarket products, and the source of infection is still under investigation. The country has reported an average of 14–22 cases per year in past years.

J03yuVGO2GH7OFwnf13ytA.zh: 愛爾蘭2024年病例數達新高,報告539例,約25%病例需住院,超過65%病例為0-5個月大嬰兒,無死亡病例,疫情趨勢延續到2025年初,預期春、夏季病例數將持續增加。
J03yuVGO2GH7OFwnf13ytA.en: Ireland's case numbers in 2024 reached a record high, with 539 cases reported. About 25% of cases required hospitalization, and over 65% of cases were infants aged 0–5 months. There were no deaths. The trend continued into early 2025, and case numbers are expected to keep rising in spring and summer.

RyNpkJzk57rnQ88DLZ0WCg.zh: 愛爾蘭西南部於去年新增該區首例確診病例,為30多歲男性,出生並成長於加勒比海國家,移居至愛爾蘭逾10年,2023年底出現右臂麻木疼痛等症狀,去年夏季確診,已康復出院。當局將加強醫護專業訓練;該國10年內累計5例病例。 韓國報告去年全年累計5例病例,皆為外國籍人士,該國自2019-23年每年新增病例數介於2-5例,多為外國人士,爰增加外國人免費篩檢次數;2023年全球約182,815例病例,其中東南亞地區佔7成。
RyNpkJzk57rnQ88DLZ0WCg.en: In southwestern Ireland, the region recorded its first confirmed case last year: a man in his 30s who was born and raised in a Caribbean country and had lived in Ireland for over 10 years. He developed numbness and pain in his right arm at the end of 2023, was confirmed last summer, and has recovered and been discharged. Authorities will strengthen professional training for healthcare workers. Ireland has recorded 5 cases over the past 10 years. South Korea reported 5 cases for the whole of last year, all in foreign nationals. Annual new cases in South Korea from 2019 to 2023 ranged from 2 to 5, mostly among foreigners, so the number of free screenings for foreigners has been increased. Globally, about 182,815 cases were reported in 2023, 70% of them in South-East Asia.

2_A4GUDc_g9TIDBANWajNg.zh: WHO於2/7公布南蘇丹新增1例I型病例、141例疑病例,指標病例為烏干達國民、該國居民,2/6確診,該國成為第22個非洲疫區國家。 愛爾蘭於2/6報告新增首例Ib型病例,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,個案刻正接受治療,當局已匡列接觸者,評估一般民眾風險仍為低。
2_A4GUDc_g9TIDBANWajNg.en: WHO announced on 7 February that South Sudan had reported 1 clade I case and 141 suspected cases. The index case is a Ugandan national and resident of South Sudan, confirmed on 6 February; the country became the 22nd African country with outbreaks. Ireland reported its first clade Ib case on 6 February. The patient has a travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and is under treatment. Authorities have listed contacts and assess the risk to the general public as still low.

zVqwO6ra7CzHBFH3jp6L3A.zh: 美國爆發大腸桿菌O121:H19疫情,截至11/17共18州累計報告39例,其中15例住院及1例死亡。發病日期介於9/6-10/28,多數病例於發病前曾食用胡蘿蔔,當局已召回疑受汙染之產品。 美國多地爆發O157疫情,明蘇達州自10/31以來報告10例,其中2例住院,發病日期介於11/4-11/9,多數病例曾食用漢堡及碎牛肉製品;密蘇里州聖路易郡報告至少97例,多數病例為某高中學生,感染源疑為學校活動提供之餐點。 愛爾蘭報告13例 O157:H7病例,無HUS病例及死亡病例;冰島報告23例,病例皆為某幼教機構學童;兩案感染源疑為食源性,惟感染源尚待調查。
zVqwO6ra7CzHBFH3jp6L3A.en:
The United States has an outbreak of E. coli O121:H19: as of 17 November, 39 cases had been reported from 18 states, of whom 15 were hospitalized and 1 died. Onset dates range from 6 September to 28 October. Most patients had eaten carrots before becoming ill, and authorities have recalled suspected contaminated products.

Multiple US locations have E. coli O157 outbreaks. Minnesota has reported 10 cases since 31 October, 2 of whom were hospitalized, with onset dates between 4 and 9 November; most patients had eaten hamburgers and ground beef products. St. Louis County, Missouri, has reported at least 97 cases; most are students at a high school, and the suspected source is meals provided at a school activity.

Ireland reported 13 E. coli O157:H7 cases, with no HUS or deaths. Iceland reported 23 cases, all among children at an early childhood education centre. In both cases the source is suspected to be foodborne, but the source is still under investigation.

veNZr8hW2j89cB2g1ptSYA.zh: 2024年第42週(10/14-10/20)全球陽性率約18.9%,陽性率以歐洲區(20.1%)、美洲區(13.5%)及非洲區(4.4%)為高。 歐洲XEC病例數呈上升趨勢,愛爾蘭最近5週XEC變異株占比約7.1%。 美國主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,另XEC變異株占比持續上升。 墨西哥今年迄今累計13,000例病例,其中638例死亡,病例分布以墨西哥城、克雷塔羅州、新萊昂州及普埃布拉州為多。
veNZr8hW2j89cB2g1ptSYA.en:
Situation update: In week 42 of 2024 (14–20 October), the global positivity rate was about 18.9%, highest in the European Region (20.1%), the Region of the Americas (13.5%) and the African Region (4.4%).

XEC cases are rising in Europe; in Ireland, the XEC variant accounted for about 7.1% over the past 5 weeks.

The main circulating variant in the United States is KP.3.1.1, and the share of XEC variants continues to rise.

Mexico has cumulatively reported 13,000 cases this year, including 638 deaths. Cases are mainly distributed in Mexico City, Querétaro State, Nuevo León State and Puebla State.
